description: Aggregated incident triage: get-incident + get-events (lookback window) + search-incidents (similar on same service, last 14d) + aggregate-logs (error spike on incident's service) in one call. Replaces the 5-step `triage-incident` Prompt orchestration with a single structured response (incident metadata, related events, similar past incidents, log-spike heuristic, and a summary block with severity/duration/spike flag). Uses Promise.allSettled — per-fetcher failures populate caveats[].

extractFields.description: Comma-separated dotted paths to project from response (e.g. 'id,name,owner.name,columns.*.name'). Use `*` as wildcard for arrays/objects. Wrap field names with dots in backticks. Reduces response tokens dramatically on large entities.

incidentId.description: Incident ID. Use list-incidents or search-incidents to find one.

includeLogSpike.description: Run an aggregate-logs spike detection over the window for the incident's service

includeSimilar.description: Search for incidents on the same service in the last 14 days

lookbackMinutes.description: Minutes before incident creation to scan for related signals (default 60, max 720)

service.description: Override the service tag scan. By default, derived from incident.fields.services[0].

name: incident-triage-snapshot
